content_metadata.description: A video podcast discussing the principles, practices, and impacts of open source electronics, featuring an introduction by Will Cleaver and an interview with Jeremy Blum.

qAndA.question: What is the name of the company Jeremy mentions that sells electronics kits and was featured on the cover of Wired Magazine?
What is the "killer app" of the open-source 3D printer "Fab@Home"?
How long does it take to make a single-layer circuit board at home, according to Jeremy Blum?

qAndA.answer: Creative Commons or GNU Public License.
qAndA.question: What type of license does Jeremy usually use for his open source hardware projects?

qAndA.answer: It requires that anyone making improvements or changes to the design must share those changes, so others can benefit from them.
qAndA.question: What is the most important aspect of the Creative Commons Share-alike clause in open-source hardware licensing?
